resources.zh_note: 当前跳转到 Nura，用于确认迁移后的现行入口；不代表任意手机都有镜像。
resources.en_note: Currently redirects to Nura and identifies the current entry point; it does not mean every phone has an image.

resources.zh_note: 按设备代号查状态与设备页；自动访问可能被 Anubis 拦截，需要人工浏览。
resources.en_note: Finds status and pages by device codename; Anubis may require manual browser review.

resources.zh_note: 包含设备包、内核和构建定义；仓库存在不等于某台手机功能完整。
resources.en_note: Contains device packages, kernels and build definitions; repository presence does not prove complete phone functionality.

zh.stage: 生态仍在运行，入口正迁移到 Nura；设备资料和代码可找到，但尚未逐机型核验。
zh.usable: 只有当前设备页明确列出准确代号、安装路径和功能状态时，才适合进入试装准备；不是通用刷机教程。
works_for: 当前设备目录明确列出的准确设备代号
有对应安装页或构建包，并具备原厂恢复资料的闲置手机
not_for: 零售名称相近但设备代号不同的机型
设备页未列出或核心功能状态未知的手机
依赖稳定通话、相机、定位等全部日常功能的主力机
zh.value: 用来判断旧手机是否存在 Linux 路线，以及功能缺口在哪里；价值是设备筛选，不是成功保证。
zh.follow: 知道设备代号、愿意读功能矩阵并能恢复原厂系统时继续；只知道品牌型号时先停。

en.stage: The ecosystem is active while entry points move to Nura. Device material and code remain available, but model-by-model review is incomplete.
en.usable: Proceed only when a current device page names the exact codename, install route and feature state. This is not a universal flashing guide.
works_for: Exact codenames listed in the current device directory
Spare phones with a matching install page or build package and a documented stock recovery route
not_for: Similar retail names with a different codename
Phones absent from the directory or with unknown core-function status
Daily-driver use requiring reliable calls, camera, positioning and every stock function
en.value: Helps determine whether an older phone has a Linux route and where functionality is missing. Its value is triage, not a success guarantee.
en.follow: Continue if you know the codename, accept feature-matrix review and can restore stock firmware; pause if you only know the retail name.

resources.zh_label: 官方支持清单与安装文档
resources.en_label: Official support list and install documentation
resources.zh_note: 列出支持设备、各主板安装入口、内部/外部刷写和安全警告，应从这里确认准确板号。
resources.en_note: Lists supported devices, board-specific routes, internal/external flashing and safety warnings; start with the exact board.

resources.zh_note: 用于获取和构建源码与镜像；适合核对构建流程，不是兼容清单。
resources.en_note: Fetches and builds source and images; useful for build review, but not a compatibility list.

resources.zh_note: 解释项目代码分别存放在哪里，用于确认上游仓库与镜像关系。
resources.en_note: Explains where project code is hosted and distinguishes upstream repositories from mirrors.

zh.stage: 上游项目与文档较完整，存在明确支持设备和安装路线；KitAgain 尚未整理全部板号。
zh.usable: 当前官方清单中的准确主板可进入安装评估；部分可内部刷写，部分必须使用外置编程器。
works_for: 官方列出的 ThinkPad X200/T400/T500/W500/R400/R500
当前支持清单中的特定 Chromebook、服务器、台式机和工作站板号
not_for: 同系列但未出现在当前支持清单的主板修订
已移除板卡或只有旧教程、没有当前 ROM 的设备
无法确认闪存芯片、备份和外部恢复条件的机器
zh.value: 支持清单足以帮助用户判断板号、刷写方式和恢复工具；主要不确定性是固件写入风险。
zh.follow: 能确认主板、完整备份闪存并准备恢复工具时继续；无法承担变砖风险时不要开始。

en.stage: The upstream project and documentation are substantial, with explicit supported devices and install routes; KitAgain has not normalized every board.
en.usable: Exact boards in the current official list can enter installation assessment. Some support internal flashing; others require external hardware.
works_for: Official ThinkPad X200/T400/T500/W500/R400/R500 routes
Official X220/X220T/T420/T420s/T520 and X230/T430/T530/W530/X230T routes
Exact Chromebook, server, desktop and workstation boards in the current list
not_for: Board revisions absent from the current list despite a similar family name
Removed boards or devices with only old instructions and no current ROM
Machines whose flash chip, backup and external recovery path cannot be confirmed
en.value: The support list can support a real board, flashing and recovery decision. Firmware-writing risk is the main issue.
en.follow: Continue if you can identify the board, back up the complete flash and prepare recovery hardware; stop if you cannot accept a non-booting machine.

resources.zh_note: 长期更新的 rootfs、内核和安装讨论入口；需要同时阅读首帖与近期回复。
resources.en_note: Long-running rootfs, kernel and installation entry; read both the first post and recent replies.

resources.zh_label: 设备与 U-Boot 讨论帖
resources.zh_note: 包含具体设备的启动、U-Boot 和恢复讨论；自动抓取可能返回 403。
resources.en_note: Contains device-specific boot, U-Boot and recovery discussion; automated fetching may return 403.

zh.stage: 社区长期维护，但知识分散在论坛首帖和多年回复中，不是统一安装包。
zh.usable: 核对准确型号、SoC、原厂 U-Boot、串口、NAND 布局和当前 rootfs 后，可作为高级改造路线。
works_for: 有专门主帖或确认启动记录的 Kirkwood 设备
NSA325、GoFlex Home、部分 Pogoplug 与 Synology 型号可作为逐帖核查起点
具备 USB-TTL、启动日志和闪存备份的闲置 NAS
not_for: 把所有 Kirkwood NAS 当成同一型号
跨品牌或 NAND 布局互换 U-Boot 环境变量
没有串口、没有备份且存有唯一数据的设备
zh.value: 能为停服或原系统过旧的 NAS 提供 Debian、内核和启动链线索，最大价值是型号专属恢复经验。
zh.follow: 有串口工具、Linux 基础并能先备份数据和闪存时继续；只想一键刷机时不要跟做。

en.stage: The community has maintained this route for years, but knowledge is spread across first posts and long reply chains rather than one installer.
en.usable: It becomes an advanced route only after verifying the exact model, SoC, stock U-Boot, serial access, NAND layout and current rootfs.
works_for: Kirkwood devices with a dedicated thread or confirmed boot report
NSA325, GoFlex Home and selected Pogoplug or Synology models as thread-review starting points
Spare NAS devices with USB-TTL, saved boot logs and flash backups
not_for: Treating every Kirkwood NAS as the same model
Mixing U-Boot environment values across brands or NAND layouts
Devices with no serial access, no backup and irreplaceable data
en.value: Provides Debian, kernel and boot-chain clues for unsupported NAS hardware; model-specific recovery experience is its strongest value.
en.follow: Continue with serial tools, Linux experience and complete backups; do not follow it if you need a one-click installer.

resources.zh_note: 说明原 Pebble 服务消失后如何切换到 Rebble，并链接当前设置流程。
resources.en_note: Explains the move from discontinued Pebble services to Rebble and links the current setup route.

resources.zh_note: 包含 Android/iOS 安装、配对、商店、天气、听写、订阅和退出 Rebble 等问题。
resources.en_note: Covers Android/iOS installation, pairing, store, weather, dictation, subscriptions and removing Rebble.

resources.zh_note: 用于查看生态内应用、服务与开发项目，不是单块手表的兼容证明。
resources.en_note: Lists ecosystem apps, services and development projects; it is not compatibility proof for one watch.

zh.stage: 社区服务已经可用，并有启用指南与帮助中心；旧应用、手机系统限制和新服务路线仍并行。
zh.usable: 很多 Pebble 手表可恢复应用商店和部分云服务，但需要可用的手机端应用；天气和听写可能依赖订阅。
works_for: 仍能开机和配对的 Pebble Classic、Steel、Time、Time Steel、Round 与 Pebble 2 系列可作为核查对象
能安装或侧载 Pebble 手机应用的 Android/iOS 用户
not_for: 假设所有新手机系统都能直接安装旧 Pebble 应用
假设所有原云功能都免费完整恢复
用云服务解决按键、屏幕或电池硬件故障
zh.value: 可判断旧 Pebble 还剩哪些软件价值、如何连接、哪些功能要订阅，以及去哪里排查问题。
zh.follow: 手表硬件正常且愿意处理手机侧兼容问题时继续；硬件损坏或不愿侧载应用时收益有限。

en.stage: Community services are usable with a setup guide and help center. Legacy apps, phone-OS limits and newer service routes still coexist.
en.usable: Many Pebble watches can regain the app store and selected cloud services, but a working phone app is required; weather and dictation may require a subscription.
works_for: Working Pebble Classic, Steel, Time, Time Steel, Round and Pebble 2 families as exact-device review candidates
Android or iOS users able to install or sideload the Pebble app
not_for: Assuming every new phone OS can directly install the legacy app
Assuming every former cloud function is restored completely and for free
Expecting cloud services to fix broken buttons, screens or batteries
en.value: Helps decide what software value remains, how connection works, which functions require subscriptions and where to troubleshoot.
en.follow: Continue if the watch hardware works and phone-side compatibility work is acceptable; value is limited for broken hardware or when sideloading is unacceptable.

resources.zh_label: 作者的 13 步安装教程
resources.zh_note: 包含 Android 上部署 Jellyfin 的完整过程和作者测试说法；缺少独立代码仓库与明确许可核验。
resources.en_note: Contains the Android Jellyfin setup and author test claims; an independently reviewed repository and clear license remain missing.

zh.stage: 有完整作者教程和多设备测试说法，但 KitAgain 尚未复现，也未确认脚本维护与许可证。
zh.usable: 可作为闲置 Android 设备运行轻量家庭媒体服务的实验；后台稳定、转码和重启恢复仍未知。
works_for: 作者报告测试过的多台 Motorola、Pixel 和 Fire Tablet，但尚无准确型号矩阵
主要承担直接播放、可长期接电并连接局域网的闲置 Android 设备
not_for: 需要可靠硬件转码、多用户高并发或公网暴露的服务器
Android 版本、CPU 架构和后台限制未核对的具体机型
存放唯一媒体副本或要求无人值守稳定运行
zh.value: 适合低成本验证旧手机能否当媒体服务器，并发现 Android 后台、存储和网络限制。
zh.follow: 有备用设备和媒体副本、能接受服务中断时继续；依赖稳定转码或唯一数据时选常规服务器。

en.stage: A complete author tutorial and multi-device claims exist, but KitAgain has not reproduced it or confirmed maintenance and licensing.
en.usable: It is an experiment for a spare Android device to host a light home media service; background reliability, transcoding and reboot recovery remain unknown.
works_for: Several Motorola devices, a Pixel and a Fire Tablet are author-reported, but no exact model matrix exists
Spare Android devices mainly serving direct-play media on a home LAN
not_for: Servers requiring dependable hardware transcoding, concurrency or public exposure
Models whose Android version, CPU architecture and background limits are unreviewed
Irreplaceable media or unattended long-term service
en.value: Useful for cheaply testing an old phone as a media server and exposing Android background, storage and network constraints.
en.follow: Continue with a spare device and copied media if interruptions are acceptable; use a conventional server for stable transcoding or unique data.

resources.zh_note: 包含 39 针屏幕、高压电源、v2 PCB、元件表、焊接问题和黑白输出进展。
resources.en_note: Documents the 39-pin panel, high-voltage rails, v2 PCB, components, soldering failures and black-and-white output.

resources.zh_note: 记录备用屏成功显示、ESP8266 内存与时序限制，以及首块屏可能损坏。
resources.en_note: Records successful output on a backup panel, ESP8266 memory/timing limits and likely damage to the first panel.

resources.zh_note: 含 gerber、pcb 和 src；README 说明代码拟用 MIT，但 PCB 与上游组件可能有其他许可。
resources.en_note: Contains gerber, pcb and src; the README proposes MIT for code while noting other possible PCB and upstream licenses.

zh.stage: v2 硬件曾正常产生电压，并在特定备用屏上得到黑白输出；灰阶和通用适配未完成。
zh.usable: 对能识别 39 针面板、会贴片焊接并理解正负高压的开发者有复刻价值；普通 Kindle 用户不能直接套用。
works_for: 项目实际使用的 39 针拆机电子纸面板及相同电气规格面板
ESP8266 或 STM32 控制实验，但需重查时序、RAM 和 PCB 修订
需要 Gerber、PCB 和驱动源码继续研究的开发者
not_for: 假设所有 Kindle 6 英寸屏或所有 39 针屏都兼容
不检查二极管方向、FPC 和修订就直接下单
完整灰阶、成品外壳或长期稳定显示
zh.value: 电源轨、连接器、PCB/代码和失败日志能减少逆向工作，但它不是即插即用产品。
zh.follow: 能读取面板编号、测量高压并自行审查 PCB 时继续；普通副屏需求应选完整方案。

en.stage: Revision 2 generated the intended rails and black-and-white output on a specific backup panel; grayscale and broad panel support are unfinished.
en.usable: Useful to developers who can identify a 39-pin panel, solder SMD parts and handle positive and negative high-voltage rails; not a drop-in Kindle route.
works_for: The tested 39-pin salvaged panel and panels with the same verified electrical specification
ESP8266 or STM32 experiments after rechecking timing, RAM and PCB revision
Developers needing Gerbers, PCB files and driver source
not_for: Assuming all six-inch Kindle or all 39-pin panels are compatible
Ordering without checking diode orientation, FPC soldering and revision
Complete grayscale, a finished enclosure or long-term stability
en.value: The power rails, connector, PCB/code and failure logs reduce reverse-engineering work, but this is not plug-and-play.
en.follow: Continue only if you can read the panel number, measure high voltage and review the PCB; choose a finished route for an ordinary second-screen need.

resources.zh_note: 说明 ED060SC4/类似屏与 Raspberry Pi 的目标，并明确两版 PCB 都有错误、无法修成可用。
resources.en_note: Explains the ED060SC4-or-similar Raspberry Pi goal and records two PCB revisions that could not be made usable.

resources.zh_note: 包含用途设想、元件与 PCB 过程，以及转向 L06 类似项目的原因。
resources.en_note: Contains intended uses, parts and PCB work, plus why the author moved toward the related L06 project.

zh.stage: 停在失败原型阶段：两版 PCB 均因设计错误不可用，作者转而参考另一块转接板。
zh.usable: 没有可以复刻并验收的成品，只适合作为失败资料、ED060SC4 研究入口和项目关系图。
works_for: 研究 ED060SC4 或相近电子纸接口的开发者
了解 Raspberry Pi 直接驱屏、PCB 设计和低功耗终端构想
查找 L06 等相邻方案
not_for: 任何 Raspberry Pi 与 Kindle 屏的可工作组合
直接下单、返修或连接两版失败 PCB
已实现太阳能笔记本、外壳、键盘或续航目标
zh.value: 明确记录哪些板子没工作、为什么停止以及应转向哪个项目，避免重复采购失败设计。
zh.follow: 只用于研究和失败复盘；找到后继修订与独立成功证据后再进入复刻。

en.stage: The project stopped at a failed prototype: two PCB revisions were unusable and the author moved toward another adapter.
en.usable: There is no buildable accepted result; it is a failure record, ED060SC4 research entry and project relationship map.
works_for: Developers researching ED060SC4 or similar e-paper interfaces
Studying direct Raspberry Pi panel drive, PCB design and low-power terminal concepts
Finding adjacent routes such as L06
not_for: Any claimed working Raspberry Pi and Kindle-panel combination
Ordering, patching or connecting either failed PCB revision
A completed solar laptop, enclosure, keyboard or battery-life goal
en.value: Records which boards failed, why work stopped and where the author turned next, preventing repeated purchases of a known-bad design.
en.follow: Use only for research and failure review; reproduce only after a successor revision and independent working evidence appear.

resources.zh_label: 11 英寸 Android 墙面板案例
resources.zh_note: 包含廉价平板、Fully Kiosk、MQTT/Node-RED、供电、随机 MAC、散热和持续充电讨论。
resources.en_note: Covers a cheap tablet, Fully Kiosk, MQTT/Node-RED, power, randomized MAC, cooling and continuous charging.

resources.zh_label: 墙面显示设备选型讨论
resources.zh_note: 比较旧手机、Android/iOS 平板、廉价 Lenovo、Xiaomi、Samsung OLED 平板和触屏笔记本。
resources.en_note: Compares used phones, Android/iOS tablets, a cheap Lenovo, Xiaomi, Samsung OLED tablet and a convertible laptop.

zh.stage: 这是多位用户的设备路线，不是单一项目；浏览器展示与 Kiosk 控制已有案例，长期安全仍需逐机验证。
zh.usable: 较新的旧平板或手机通常可作 Home Assistant 仪表板终端，适合显示和轻量控制，不等于适合隐藏式长期供电。
works_for: 社区建议约 2GB RAM 以上、较新 Android/iOS 和可用 WebView/浏览器的设备
帖子中的 11 英寸廉价 Android 平板能显示，但性能差且有随机 MAC 问题
Xiaomi 平板、Samsung OLED 平板和 iPad 9 等可作为进一步试用对象
not_for: 非常老的 WebView 或低内存设备流畅显示复杂仪表板
无充电上限、背部发热或电池老化的平板长期挂墙
ESP32 屏幕直接运行完整 Lovelace 网页
zh.value: 先用现有设备测试性能、Kiosk、断电恢复和充电策略，再决定墙体布线和支架。
zh.follow: 先在桌面连续试用；性能和充电限制合格后再上墙。鼓包、异常热或变形立即淘汰。

en.stage: This is a multi-user pattern rather than one project. Browser dashboards and kiosk control are demonstrated; long-term safety still needs device-specific checks.
en.usable: A reasonably recent spare tablet or phone can often serve as a Home Assistant dashboard terminal for display and light control, but that does not establish safe concealed continuous power.
works_for: Community guidance suggests roughly 2 GB RAM or more, recent Android/iOS and a usable WebView/browser
The reported cheap 11-inch Android tablet displays a dashboard but is slow and has randomized-MAC issues
Xiaomi tablets, a Samsung OLED tablet and iPad 9 are candidates for further trial
not_for: Very old WebView or low-memory devices rendering complex dashboards smoothly
Aged tablets without charge limits, with heat or worn batteries in permanent wall use
An ESP32 display running a full Lovelace web dashboard directly
en.value: Tests performance, kiosk behavior, power-loss recovery and charging before committing to wiring and a wall mount.
en.follow: Run it on a desk first; mount only after performance and charge limits pass. Retire swelling, unusually hot or deformed devices immediately.

resources.zh_label: Raspberry Pi 官方分步教程
resources.zh_note: 包含 Play:1 拆机、Pi 3 A+/Zero 2、4Ω 扬声器、DAC/功放、20V 供电、系统与音频测试，并有市电电容警告。
resources.en_note: Covers Play:1 disassembly, Pi 3 A+/Zero 2, 4-ohm drivers, DAC/amplifier, 20 V power, OS, audio tests and a mains-capacitor warning.

zh.stage: 教程形成完整作者构建路线，可复用 Play:1 箱体和扬声器；KitAgain 尚未复现或核对全部修订。
zh.usable: 故障或闲置 Play:1 可移除原主板并改成树莓派有源音箱；需要拆机、焊接、匹配功放和市电安全经验。
works_for: 扬声器单元正常的 Sonos Play:1 箱体与 4Ω 单元
教程使用的 Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+，以及明确提到的 Raspberry Pi Zero 2
能驱动 4Ω 单元的 DAC/功放组合和独立 20V 供电
not_for: 假设其他 Sonos 型号内部空间、阻抗和接线相同
保留原主板功能、Sonos 多房间协议或认证
没有市电设备安全经验的人处理原主板电容
zh.value: 完成度较高，能直接判断所需 Pi、功放、供电和软件步骤；核心价值是机械与电气路线。
zh.follow: 有焊接和市电安全经验且扬声器单元正常时继续；只想软件解锁或无法安全放电时不要尝试。

en.stage: The tutorial presents a complete author build reusing the Play:1 enclosure and drivers; KitAgain has not reproduced it or reviewed every revision.
en.usable: A failed or unused Play:1 can become a Raspberry Pi powered speaker after removing the original board. It requires disassembly, soldering, amplifier matching and mains safety.
works_for: A Sonos Play:1 enclosure with working 4-ohm speaker assembly
Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+ as used, with Raspberry Pi Zero 2 explicitly offered as an alternative
A DAC/amplifier for 4-ohm speakers and an isolated 20 V supply
not_for: Assuming other Sonos models share the same space, impedance and wiring
Retaining original mainboard functions, Sonos multi-room protocol or certification
Users without mains-equipment safety experience handling board capacitors
en.value: A relatively complete build that exposes the Pi, amplifier, power and software path; its main value is mechanical and electrical guidance.
en.follow: Continue with soldering and mains-safety experience when the drivers work; do not attempt it for software-only unlocking or without safe discharge handling.

resources.zh_label: 作者项目页与演示说明
resources.zh_note: 列出 ESP32、VS1053、外置天线、两套代码和视频演示，作者标记为 completed project。
resources.en_note: Lists ESP32, VS1053, external antenna, two code variants and a video demonstration; the author marks it completed.

resources.zh_label: 通用 VS1053 版本源码
resources.zh_note: 面向 ESP32-WROOM-32U 与通用 VS1053 板，用于核对引脚、依赖和配置。
resources.en_note: Targets ESP32-WROOM-32U and a generic VS1053 board for reviewing pinout, dependencies and configuration.

resources.zh_note: 包含接线、配置、库依赖和 Apache-2.0 许可证。
resources.en_note: Contains wiring, configuration, library dependencies and an Apache-2.0 license.

resources.zh_note: 用于听取作者演示；本轮确认链接，未做音质测量。
resources.en_note: Provides the author's demonstration; this review confirms the link without measuring audio quality.

zh.stage: 作者标记为完成，并给出两套源码、硬件组成和演示；KitAgain 尚未测量音质、延迟、噪声和稳定性。
zh.usable: 可把手机 A2DP 音频通过 ESP32+VS1053 输出到旧音响线路输入；更适合做外置接收盒。
works_for: ESP32-WROOM-32U、外置天线与通用 VS1053 MP3 板
普通 ESP32 加 Adafruit VS1053 breakout 的作者路线
有 AUX、Line In 等线路电平输入的旧音响
not_for: 只有喇叭端子、没有线路输入的无源音箱
ESP32 直接驱动大功率扬声器
低延迟视频同步、发烧级音质或所有蓝牙编码格式
zh.value: 能以可回退的外置盒方式给旧功放增加手机蓝牙输入，元件和源码路线清楚。
zh.follow: 音响有线路输入且能装配低压模块时继续；要求高保真、超低延迟或必须拆市电机箱时选成品接收器。

en.stage: The author marks it completed and provides two code variants, hardware components and a demo; KitAgain has not measured quality, latency, noise or stability.
en.usable: It can route phone A2DP audio through ESP32+VS1053 into an older stereo's line input, best as a reversible external receiver box.
works_for: ESP32-WROOM-32U with external antenna and generic VS1053 MP3 board
A regular ESP32 with the author's Adafruit VS1053 breakout route
Older stereos with AUX, Line In or another line-level input
not_for: Passive speakers with only speaker terminals
An ESP32 directly driving high-power speakers
Low-latency video sync, audiophile quality or every Bluetooth codec
en.value: Adds phone Bluetooth input to an old amplifier through a reversible external box with clear parts and source routes.
en.follow: Continue if the stereo has line input and you can assemble low-voltage modules; choose a finished receiver for high fidelity, very low latency or mains-enclosure work.
